description: Construct a bounded segment only after the project defines churn eligibility, observation windows and approved profile dimensions.

guide.applicability: Use for descriptive segment work when churn and cohort semantics are reviewed and user-level handling is authorized.
guide.context_boundary: A profile describes returned members; it cannot reveal unreturned users, sensitive traits or reasons for churn without stronger evidence.
steps: Resolve the churn event, eligibility window, cohort and allowed profile dimensions.
Apply a reviewed segment-profile Operator to governed returned rows with privacy and minimum-sample checks.
Separate descriptive traits from hypotheses and suppress unsupported sensitive or causal interpretations.
guide.title: Governed churn-segment profile

summary: Define and profile a churn segment without guessing identity or behavioral causes.
